I went and used the app directly, and everything I care about works. Saving a link pulls in the page's title automatically and falls back gracefully when details are missing; new saves default to "to read"; I can mark things read, favorite them, tag them (and equivalent tags don't duplicate); saving the same link again warns me and offers to edit the existing one; archiving hides a bookmark from the main and to-read views but keeps everything, and restoring brings it back with its tags, favorite, and read status all intact; permanent delete removes it for good; and search (case-insensitive), filtering, and sorting all return what I'd expect. It stays saved too.

The empty library in the static screenshot threw me at first, but that was just a fresh/clean state — the live app behaves correctly. This is the bookmark manager I wanted. I'm accepting it.

Thank you — nicely done.

<FINAL_ACCEPTED>
